description: Resident repair layer for DeepSeek Harness: splits glued tool-call JSON at proven boundaries, re-throws what it cannot prove, and names what it will not fix.
plugin_description: DeepSeek Harness patch set that intercepts MALFORMED_RESPONSE streams, splits fused tool-call arguments, re-throws unprovable buffers, and names the deterministic refusals it does not retry.
core_description: Pure repair and redaction engine for the dsh-remedy patch set. Nothing unproven is ever emitted; a failure it cannot split is re-thrown unchanged.
release_blurb:
### Release status

`0.3.8` is shipped and published as `latest` for both `dsh-remedy` and `dsh-remedy-core`, with `0.3.7` as the previous release.

P-0001, P-0002 and P-0003 are verified on a real host: a fusion was repaired end to end, a synthesized call was dispatched, and a budget refusal wrote a non-zero `refused` instead of pretending to repair. Every other patch is `tested`: each has unit tests and negative controls, and a measured fixture, scan or corpus where one exists.

This release adds the plugin's second seam, `agent/request-error`, which had no test at all since 0.2.0 and called `next()` before overriding an answer the runtime documents must not be overridden. It also names the deterministic refusals that used to kill a turn silently, and adds `dsh-remedy explain`, which prints per failure class how often this machine hit it, which patch covers it, and whether that patch is on in a named profile.

Live evidence: [data/results/live-2026-11-12T12-20-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-12T12-20-00.000Z.json), [data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json) and [data/results/live-2026-11-10T16-30-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-10T16-30-00.000Z.json).
